messages:
maya: Heads up — embeddings service returning 503s in eu-west1 since 06:12 UTC. Rolling errors at ~8% p95 across requests. Need hotfix deploy (hotpatch v2.3.1). Can we fast-track approvals and skip canary? https://status.redwood.example/incident/321

sam: what's blast radius? is this customer-facing or internal batch jobs?

maya: customer-facing — search/semantic rank. Affects ~2% of production traffic, error increases with concurrency. Root cause looks like KVCACHE overflow after quant-path change in last deploy.

elena: agreed this is user impacting. Suggest pin to previous stable (v2.3.0) on eu-west1 only, then stage a quick patch for global. Can we do a targeted cutover?

maya: yes — plan: pin eu-west1 to v2.3.0, then deploy hotpatch v2.3.1 to staging -> eu-west1 after smoke. Need 2 eng + ops signoff to skip regular 30m canary window.

leo: ops: does infra have capacity to roll back without tail risk? @ops-oncall

ops-oncall: infra ok for a targeted pin and rollforward. We can do a staged cutover with traffic shift 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 8 minutes. I'll watch metrics. Need approvals from two owners.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline queued: release/v2.3.1-hotfix (sha: a1b2c3). Canaries configured: eu-west1 only. Estimated time to rollout: 6m. Checks: e2e (fail fast), perf smoke.

sam: I sign off to skip full canary if smoke passes and ops-oncall monitors. :thumbsup:

elena: +1 from me. Also add a quick synthetic check against top 10 queries and alert if error >1%.

leo: +1 — approve expedited. Condition: rollback plan in place and release notes updated with mitigation steps and PR link.

maya: copying deploy command to run after approvals:

`````
deploy-bot release start --env eu-west1 --version v2.3.1 --strategy staged --shift 10,50,100 --monitor synthetic,ops-oncall
`````

maya: tagging release notes: https://git.redwood/example/release-notes/123

deploy-bot: execute approved by users: sam, elena, leo. Starting pipeline in 60s.

ops-oncall: monitoring live, smoke passed first 2m. No new 5xx spikes.

sam: observed latency stable, embedding error rate back to baseline.

elena: confirming client-visible errors resolved in eu-west1. green.

maya: closing thread — hotfix deployed and pinned. Will follow up with postmortem. Thanks everyone :heart:
